LOD-KEY-VISIBILITY-001 — ALL-ANGLE JAIL KEY AND JUMPABLE PEDESTAL [AUTHOR-REQUESTED; 2026-10-13]
The recoverable Jail Key must remain conspicuous from every viewing direction. Correct native render bounds for the complete display, use a thick upright gold key that faces the viewer, and provide a real solid pedestal beneath it. The pedestal is tall enough to identify above the floor but low and narrow enough for an ordinary jump to clear if it lands in a constrained passage. Bright gold/ivory against deep blue-violet and dark trim provide hue and luminance contrast; retain a readable key silhouette and text so identification never depends on color alone. Keep wall occlusion, existing boss/drop position, pickup radius, active-Hero admission, exact boss receipt and progression/lifecycle ownership. The pedestal belongs to the same key entity and disappears on collection/reset; no extra actor, light, particles, network stream or movable physics clutter. Dimensions, palette, facing geometry and bounds are IMPLEMENTATION-TUNABLE within this contract. The native client-model portrait must retain the living unarmed Hermit presentation without assuming scripted-base-only animation methods.
tuning:
LOD-KEY-VISIBILITY-TUNING-001 — KEY PEDESTAL AND FINITE GATE [IMPLEMENTATION-TUNABLE; 2026-10-13]
Jail Key presentation | Solid fixed pedestal | 40×40×28 Source units, base aligned at existing key origin minus KeycardHeight (40); only the pedestal collides, never the floating key/label | AUTHOR-REQUESTED IMPLEMENTATION TUNING | Raised recognizable objective with a low, narrow ordinary-jump fail-safe | Native jump/visibility acceptance pending.
Jail Key presentation | Palette and display | Deep blue-violet RGB 48/32/112, ivory 255/248/222, dark trim 18/20/28, gold 255/222/104; thick upright viewer-facing key; complete 128×128 render footprint from deck to highest beacon plus margin; Reduced Effects suppresses bob/pulse | IMPLEMENTATION-TUNABLE | Complementary hue and luminance contrast plus silhouette/text; normal depth occlusion; no added entity/light/network/RNG | Finite gate below; native color/shape/FPS acceptance pending.
Finite gate: reproduce the portrait nil-method defect with an actual client-model API boundary; prove named unarmed cycle and cache remain. Verify real key Initialize/Draw/Think, complete bounds from cardinal/elevated/below views and all bob extrema, physical hull height/footprint, pickup through hull contact, denied pickup remaining jumpable, collection/reset/full-update lifecycle, Reduced Effects, wall-depth state and bounded render work. Reuse boss-key/receipt, friendly idle, lore/portrait, floor-map, low-end and installer regressions. Native gm_flatgrass gate: open Hermit dialogue without an error; after the boss, orbit/approach the visible key, observe pedestal and recognizable gold display, then jump onto/over it and collect normally. Static checks do not prove Source appearance/collision or Steam Deck FPS; publication and hosting remain separate.
